rounds.text: Texel Industries Ltd trades at a modest P/E ratio of 19.6x and a P/B of 2.11x on a book value of ₹ 34.9, valuing the ₹ 104 Cr market capitalisation attractively [E1, E2, E3]. This valuation is significantly discounted relative to the broader sector, where the benchmark P/E stands at 46.3x and the P/B at 2.98x [E6, E7]. Furthermore, the company demonstrates superior operational efficiency with a return on assets of 4.26%, easily outperforming the sector benchmark of -4.12% [E8]. Fundamental profitability remains solid, backed by a good profit growth of 19.1% CAGR over the last 5 years [E58]. Recent momentum also signals positive change, as profit growth exceeds 1-year price growth by 3254% and sales are up quarter-over-quarter [E56, E66]. Conceded: the company has delivered a poor sales growth of 3.70% over the past five years and a TTM decline of -14% [E15, E17, E61].
